notes.title: Mardi Gras Update/Event
notes.content:
The city is decked out for the Mardi Gras festivities, and we have 6 exciting limited edition items available! Get the details on how you can get yours before they are gone for good after February 22 by clicking on the Mardi Gras hat icon at the top of the game screen.

[b]Bead Collecting 2024[/b]
Join up with the rest of the community and collect the most Mardi Gras beads from the casinos of GoldFire City! Click the beads icon next to the promo icon to see the progress and get details on how to participate in this community-wide contest. Participants that reach their goal and the community goal will receive a new limited edition trophy item!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31719929/0f5118757b52e95ffeb7ee1996d1d6c94d1b62bf.jpg[/img]

[b]FEATURE[/b] New "sale lock" feature in the vault that allows you to lock specific types of items so that they won't be sold when using the "sell all" feature in the vault. Simply click the lock icon on the item to toggle this functionality.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Just like with employee wages/counts, the room rates for hotels are now inputs that can be typed into instead of just using the +/- buttons.
[b]UPDATE[/b] When listing a casino for sale at the Real Estate Market, you must now wait an hour after vaulting or selling items from that casino to allow the stats to update.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The "new listing" window at the Real Estate Market now has a search bar to filter your casinos by name or address.
[b]UPDATE[/b] When a holiday event is running, the items that get decorated around the city will now show as the normal non-decorated versions in the Auction House, Vault and Build views to avoid confusion.
[b]FIX[/b] If other players are moving by keyboard, they would sometimes get relatively far out of sync of where they were actually standing, which could cause confusion especially with bomb parties, etc.
[b]FIX[/b] The keyboard syncing improvements had a side-effect of fixing a rare instance where players could effectively phase through a barrier (though we still maintain that the only fool-proof way of protecting a floor is with the VIP feature).
[b]FIX[/b] The maximum slot score leaderboard for the current month was only updating when you got a new personal best, rather than a new personal best for the month.
[b]FIX[/b] Using the taxi to go to some casinos wouldn't always take you to the right building.
[b]FIX[/b] Various issues with the new bingo missions.
[b]FIX[/b] In rare instances, some real estate auctions would end twice, awarding two different winners.
[b]FIX[/b] Casino Points will no longer update to show "0" when playing Roulette (this was always just a visual glitch).
[b]FIX[/b] Rotations for some of the sauna items were wrong.
[b]FIX[/b] Various server error fixes.

notes.title: Summer Event & Update
notes.content:
We have 6 new limited edition summer-themed items available for your casinos! Get the details on how you can get yours before they are gone for good after August 6 by clicking on the beach ball icon at the top of the game screen.

It wouldn't be summer without over-eating from the grill! Click on the hot dog icon next to the promo icon to see the progress and get details on how to participate in this community-wide hot dog eating contest. Participants that reach their goal and the community goal will receive a limited edition Hot Dog Eating Trophy item!

[b]FEATURE[/b] Similar to the trade chat channel we recently added, there is now an "events" chat channel for things like CA events, wars, poker leagues, etc. There is also a setting to hide this from your quick chat.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Adjusted the rendering of the iOS and Android apps to lower battery usage, in some cases by as much as 2x.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The name and description of each mission giver is now displayed when clicking on them on the mini-map.
[b]UPDATE[/b] To get poker more in-line with all of the other casino games, there are now level limits applied to the tables you can join based on the stakes of the table.
[b]UPDATE[/b] A chat message deleted by a CA versus a user is now made clear.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Added a setting to select behavior when exiting a free daily spin collected from a party bomb.
[b]UPDATE[/b] There is now an info button on the ATM menu giving more information about how Party Bombs work.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The "GET CA" button in chat is now "HELP" and gives information about getting both community and technical support.
[b]FIX[/b] After completing a slot tournament, the phone app windows could sometimes get stuck on the screen at half opacity.
[b]FIX[/b] It was possible to get stuck on a black screen after joining a slot tournament.
[b]FIX[/b] Slot tournament countdown time is now synced to server time to help keep everyone on the same countdown.
[b]FIX[/b] Moving an elevator now works correctly on hotel floors.
[b]FIX[/b] A variety of issues that could cause changes to a floor to not persist.
[b]FIX[/b] Various issues with getting stuck during bingo games.
[b]FIX[/b] Bingo wasn't correctly showing the doubled XP on the client (it was being awarded correctly on the server).
[b]FIX[/b] Crew upgrade purchases wouldn't always go to the right thing on mobile.
[b]FIX[/b] A duplicated notice would be sent when visiting a hotel floor.
[b]FIX[/b] A variety of server errors that could cause all sorts of different random bugs, including disconnects.
[b]FIX[/b] A variety of client errors that could cause all sorts of different random bugs.

notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.content:
The holidays are upon us and the festivities are in full swing in CasinoRPG! We have a huge Holiday Gifting event that can earn you a special trophy item if you meet the goals. We've also released 6 limited edition classic toy-themed items that will only be available during the event, which concludes the evening of January 4.

We've also released a bunch of updates lately, which include:

[*] Updated the Steam app to use the latest renderer for better performance and stability.
[*] Moved servers to a new hosting provider for better performance and stability.
[*] Added the ability to sell all or some of your vault items with a single click using the new actions menu.
[*] There is a new reward for reaching the almighty level 100 other than a medal - the new Casino God Trophy item!
[*] Added 16 new exclusive items for Party Bombs and Daily Spins (includes new poker tables, blackjack tables, golden roulette, golden solitaire and more).
[*] New designs for Party Bombs from each of the holiday ATMs.
[*] Created a new in-line updates display to make it easier to see the latest additions to the game.
[*] Fixed a few memory leaks related to dropping Party Bombs.
[*] Lots and lots of bug fixes!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WF1OnOC.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lZAFR7Y.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
It is Halloween in GoldFire City and we are running a huge trick-or-treat event! Participation in the event can earn you a special Trick-or-Treat Trophy item (if you meet the goals). We've also released 6 limited edition vampire-themed items that will only be available during the event, which concludes the evening of November 9.

This update is also packed with new features and improvements, including:

[list]
[*] Tired of waiting for others to join you for a round of bingo? That wait is now over as we've built bots into bingo that will play with you until other real players join to take their spots!
[*] Items in your vault can now be directly gifted to your friends for a small postage fee! Simply go to their profile and click on the "Send Gift" option in the actions list (previously "transfer chips"). You can also still send chips through this same window.
[*] Party Bombs can now be purchased in packs of 5 (with a wait time of 50 minutes).
[*] Each player now has an "available for battle" toggle from their crew's battle window. Toggling this off will prevent you from being able to participate in any battles that occur while it is unchecked, but it also lowers your team's "active" count which is used to determine team size. So, if any of your crew members won't be available for a battle, you can still start a battle challenge without worrying about being at a disadvantage.
[*] There is now the option to cancel a battle challenge for a full refund before a match has been made with another crew.
[*] There are now descriptions for medals in both your profile window and on the list of medals accessed via the toolbar (some are still kept a secret until you unlock them).
[*] Citizens can now click an address in a player's profile to be taken directly to that location (non-citizens will have the location added as a waypoint).
[*] Added new medals for reaching level 125 and level 150.
[*] All new and past Halloween limited edition ATM machines now give jack-o-lanterns as party bombs.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nJL3u71.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Crew Battle/War Updates
notes.content:
The last few updates to the game have been focussed on improving the crew battle/war systems to make them more fair, balanced and easy to use. Due to varying crew sizes, this was often not the case, so we've made the following changes:

[list]
[*] Crew rankings were not very transparent, so we've overhauled them and made the formula public in the wiki: https://guide.casinorpg.com/crews/overview. We've also added a new monthly ranking to the crew listings.
[*] Crew battles now have fixed-size teams. When a battle is pending, your crew leaders can select who will participate in the battle, with the team size set to the smaller crew's active player count.
[*] Crews are no longer automatically entered into wars. Once a war gets declared, your crew has 2 days to join the war. Once your crew has joined, each individual member can join and your crew only pays the entry fee for those that actually want to participate.
[*] Once the teams are set, a lottery will be run for each day of the war to balance out the teams. If the teams aren't the same size, the larger of the two teams will randomly select players to sit out for that day.
[*] Lots of other bug fixes and tweaks to improve the battle/war experience.
[/list]

We've made these changes based on all of your feedback, so please keep it coming and we'll continue to make improvements!
